basis: Independent expected values from synthetic fixture manifest plus explicit source refresh; not serving input or an LLM judge.

turns.question: What are the breakfast hours?
turns.expected: 07:00-10:00 from current approved source; cite breakfast fact, no unsupported extra claims.

turns.question: What are the breakfast hours now?
turns.expected: 08:00-11:00 from refreshed approved source; do not reuse the old hours or old assistant prose as evidence.

turns.question: Can you confirm those breakfast hours now?
turns.expected: Unknown or cannot confirm after known source revocation; neither v1 nor v2 hours asserted as current, no obsolete evidence/media.

limits: 3 guest turns opt-in; existing whole-turn/call/output/context limits; no automatic paid retry or LLM judge. Record failures and provider usage. Offline UI/media/race checks precede live.
